title: Ram Aur Shyam
description: After escaping his dangerous brother-in-law, Ram disappears from home. His twin brother Shyam accidentally takes his place, triggering confusion, family drama, and a fight for justice.

title: Hello Brother
description: After being shot by tycoon Khanna, cop Vishal survives through a heart transplant. Teaming up with the spirit of his donor, Hero, he sets out to expose Khanna's drug empire and avenge his death.

title: Ishqiya
description: Khalujan and Babban, two small-time crooks, both fall for Krishna, their late friend's widow. But their love turns dangerous as Krishna cleverly manipulates them to serve her own selfish motives.

title: Sultan
description: After losing his son, wrestler Sultan Ali Khan quits the sport. Years later, he returns to the ring to reclaim his lost respect and win the prize money, reigniting his fighting spirit.

title: Suhaag
description: Two brothers separated by fate reunite to fight injustice, corruption and criminals, proving that courage and family bonds can overcome every challenge.

title: Bumper Draw
description: Sunderlal and Farooq befriend each other in odd circumstances, but when they meet wealthy Pestonji, they hatch a cunning plan to use him to escape their money troubles.

title: Cinebuzz
description: Celebrity interviews, movie reviews, and the latest Bollywood buzz-Cinebuzz brings you the glam and gossip straight from the heart of Indian cinema.

title: Nishant - The Night's End
description: Vishvam, one of four brothers, rules a village with his father. When schoolmaster's wife is abducted, village revolts; is Vishvam involved, and will she reunite.

title: Roti
description: When Mangal, a seasoned criminal, is sentenced to death, he escapes from prison with the help of a gang lord. While he attempts to start a new life, the police look for him.

title: Judwaa
description: Raja and Prem Malhotra, twin brothers separated at birth, reunite by fate. Together, they fight gangster Ratanlal to protect their family and reclaim the bond they never knew.

title: Dil Ka Rishta
description: Jai, a wealthy man, accidentally kills Tia's husband in a car accident. Wracked with guilt, he cares for her after she loses her memory, and fate leads her to fall in love with him.

title: Halla Bol
description: Ashfaque, a small-town dreamer turned Bollywood superstar, sees his glamorous life take a dark turn when he becomes the key witness in a shocking murder case that puts his fame and safety at risk.

title: Seetharamam
description: Afreen returns to Pakistan to deliver a letter from Ram to Sita, as her grandfather wished. Meeting Ram, she discovers a moving story of love, loss, and connection.

title: Raja Hindustani
description: Raja, a taxi driver, marries Aarti despite her wealthy family's objections. But her stepmother plots to create misunderstandings between them, threatening their love and happiness.

title: Mann
description: Dev and Priya fall in love despite being engaged to others and promise to reunite after six months to marry. But when fate intervenes, their hopes for a future together face unexpected obstacles.
